title: Pin drip-rate calibrator notes (scratch)
content:
Context:
- Personal scratchpad for upcoming microdrip/pinback experiment on model-flip (v2 -> v2q).
- Goal: minimize user-experienced regressions while shifting 10% -> 50% traffic over a 6hr window. Emphasis on graceful pinback (fast), and predictable cost delta.

High-level plan (working):
1) Warmup cohort (3%) for 30 minutes to prime KV caches + populate prefix cache.
2) Microdrip ramp: add 1% every 10 minutes until 10%. Hold 30m.
3) Smooth ramp: add 2% every 20m until 50% (approx 6 hr total from 10%).
4) Observability gates: only proceed if core signals within thresholds. If any gate trips, trigger immediate pinback to last stable fraction and open incident channel.

Telemetry & gates (candidate thresholds):
- P95 latency (route/model): no > +120ms vs baseline (baseline = last 24h mean).
- Error rate (4xx/5xx combined): < 0.15% absolute increase.
- Token-level quality regressions (automatic eval subset): pass rate >= 97% on smoke prompts.
- Upstream rate-limited rejections (quota): 0 sustained increases >10/min.
- Cost per token delta: record if > +18% and alert (manual review).

Quick checklist (pre-run):
- [ ] Bake model variant: ensure v2q artifact built and validated in staging.
- [ ] Canary infra: pre-provision dedicated pool (if warmup traffic >5%).
- [ ] Prometheus/trace retention window set to 2h for high-fidelity slices.
- [ ] Create short-lived dashboard (traffic slice + eval pass rate + latency + downstream error).
- [ ] Slack channel #deploy-wire with on-call + eng leads invited.
- [ ] Notify Solutions Eng customers flagged for this test (list in linked confluence).

Runbook snippets (to copy into incident):
- Pinback command (internal API): POST /api/deploys/pinback {"route": "text-generate", "fraction": 0.12, "variant": "stable"} // requires ops token
- Quick rollback (all traffic): POST /api/deploys/force-roll {"route": "text-generate", "variant": "stable"}
- Emergency throttle: set-rate-limit on route to 60rps for 5m via console -> RateLimits -> text-generate

Observations to capture during run (notes format):
- Time / Fraction / Active GPUs (dedicated vs shared) / P95 / Error% / Eval pass% / Observed anomalies (client complaints, spikes)

Priming heuristics (why warmup helps):
- Larger context hits: warm cohorts trigger KV cache warm and reduce first-token hotspot on newer compiled kernels.
- Short-lived cohorts reduce sudden mismatch in sequence-length distribution. Keep warmup cohort small but long enough (30m–1h).

Open questions / hypotheses to test:
- Is 1%/10m microdrip conservative enough given request burstiness? Hypothesis: yes for multi-tenant; may be too slow for single-tenant big customer.
- Does quantized kernel compilation latency cause transient tail spikes on node startup? Plan: observe node-level boot traces; test pre-warming nodes in staging with synthetic traffic.
- Are our eval smoke prompts representative of top-10 real-world failure modes? Need to pull recent failure incidents (query: RELEASE-4721).

Post-run tasks (if smooth):
- Write up quick postmortem: include heatmap of latency vs fraction, cost delta, and client feedback.
- Promote model variant to default if no regressions for 72h and cost improvements > threshold.

Notes to self (short):
- Avoid relying purely on aggregate P95; slice by client cohort 1/10/100 to catch tenant-specific regressions.
- Keep a small pinned bucket (~2%) as immutable fallback during entire ramp (fast fail target).
- Consider automating microdrip via simple state machine rather than manual increments; but only after 3 successful manual runs.

Scratch commands (local):
# probe EV cache hit rates (requires creds)
# ./tools/probe_cache_hits --route text-generate --variant v2q --window 1800

# synthetic load (staging)
# k6 run scripts/short-burn.js --vus 50 --duration 10m --env VARIANT=v2q

Misc links & refs:
- GH PR (infra): https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1942
- Jira: RELEASE-4721 (rollout plan + customer opt-ins)
- Confluence spec: conf:12345-rollout-spec

End of scratchpad.
Notes: keep this private; will extract a cleaner checklist for product/ops after first successful run.
